name: Welcome to the [unofficial] Washiez Promotion Logs!
desc:
**Washiez Promotion Logs**
Founded by Anna & Mila

> This board is **unofficial** and is maintained only for fun. Based on EST/EDT.

Welcome to the Trello Board where we log **current/former Management+ members and Staff of the Week**. This initially started as a small, little idea that we sparked together. We thought it would be awesome to see how our fellow Washians progress through their journey in this massive group, so we kicked off with the creation of this Trello board on **July 31st, 2023**!

**Disclaimer:** Not all information is correct/included; however, we try to provide as much information as we can and as accurately as possible. Should there be any edits needed for the card, please reach out to an editor. If you have any concerns about the board's technicalities—or if you would like to become a member of our staff team—feel free to reach out through our Discord server.

- Hope | hrtsformila

**"I would like to take part of the Staff Team!"**
Review the information provided in [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1x6CTg7BoiEvP5GM6m5kzBBu7GybkMDA74ss0sgscMDE/edit?tab=t.0](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1x6CTg7BoiEvP5GM6m5kzBBu7GybkMDA74ss0sgscMDE/edit?tab=t.0 "smartCard-inline"). We are generally lenient; however, we have protocols which we enforce here.

---

**”I notice a piece of information that is missing/wrong!”**
Since the Trello Board is not owned officially by the Washiez Leadership, there will be missing/wrong information. If you find one, you may report through a ticket or in an Editor's DMs.

**Include relevant information, you may send the individual's Washiez journey:**

- roblox username
- Supervision+ promotion date
- promoter
- department (Corporate only)
- Management+ resignation date (if resigned prior)
- Staff of the Week
- etc.

**If the individual is a former Management+ member, also include:**

- highest obtained-rank
- Management+ resignation date
- every department they've been in (Corporate only)

Please note that the individual must have a Former role in the Washiez Discord server. If the individual decides to leave the server, they will be removed from the Trello board.

---

**Miscellaneous Concerns**
For questions, suggestions, user reports, punishments, and other concerns, you may send through a ticket or in an admin’s DMs.

**User Report**
When reporting an individual, do ensure that you have evidence ready to send. Rest assured that your identity will be disclosed to only yourself and the admins.

**Punishments**
When discussing your punishment, do keep in mind that it is only revokable if false or out-of-line. Your punishment may be lessened if improvement is shown. Ban appeal is provided here: [https://dyno.gg/form/61df505b](https://dyno.gg/form/61df505b "smartCard-inline") .

name: How to become an editor?
desc:
When you sign up to join the Editor Team, you will start as a Junior Editor. No activity requirements will be given as there are infinite spots for that rank. Do note that you won’t have editing permissions on the Trello board as that is only granted to Senior Editors.

If you would like to join the Editor Team, you must fill out an application in the [Discord server](https://discord.com/invite/R6a8erzhpy "‌"). Run the command **/apply** with \@‌Appy to do so. The point of the application is simply to inform you about the Editor Team, so there is no way you fail unless you are not a Supervision+ member or are blacklisted.

[https://docs.google.com/document/d/1x6CTg7BoiEvP5GM6m5kzBBu7GybkMDA74ss0sgscMDE/edit?tab=t.0](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1x6CTg7BoiEvP5GM6m5kzBBu7GybkMDA74ss0sgscMDE/edit?tab=t.0 "smartCard-inline")

name: Anna | carehood
desc:
hi, my name is **Anna**
and I found the **unofficial Washiez Promotion Logs Trello** **Board** with Hope on July 31st, 2023.

---

my journey at Washiez began when I joined as **Customer on June 1st, 2022** when this good fellow banddayhaw (if you understand Spanish, try to translate it and then ping Evie about how DUMB she is), evistte, and another good fellow friend, poisoncows, discovered the group for me.

during the early months of Washiez’s popularity, there was a thing called MR applications. mind you, i had never been that serious about this group during this time, especially considering the events that had happened during the surge of its popularity. however, i still wanted to apply just to be in the Supervision Team with evistte, natstte, and emiIybeaar. and so, with the power of reused answers, I was granted the highest MR rank that any of the applicants could ever receive: **Service Manager on August 3rd, 2022**, with my friend ell6iee.

since that day, i’ve only attended 15 training sessions throughout the year of 2022 (i hated the selection process) and obtained barely any minutes at the car wash. however, even with the lack of activity, i managed to get **Assistant Manager on September 25th, 2022** (thanks to Service Manager being deleted) and **General Manager on November 7th, 2022** (thank you, BriCaprisun).

despite having such a high rank in the Supervision Team, i was quite a lonely person at Washiez. i never really had anyone to talk to there, and i was always rejoining then re-leaving the Discord server… but then a friendly Hispanic resident of California came to me: this wonderful man would be known as xxxmrxcleanxxx.

with this newly-created connection, i continued to leave the Discord server (sorry, Mr. Clean). but then, on March 5th, 2023, i had a surge of motivation. i became an ultimate try-hard at Washiez, and that try-hardedness would eventually earn me a **Staff of the Week on March 19th, 2023** (thank you, rachvii) with a little small Supervisor who would later grow up to become a part of Public Relations: **tegr1dyfarms (currently known as hrtsforhope)**. and then, a month since the start of my try-hard era, i would magically disappear.

and then, after 6 months, i REAPPEARED on October 7th, 2023, to resume my era of try-harding. and with all the bloody tears that i have shed throughout the long year of being a General Manager, i became a **Junior Director on December 13th, 2023**, by promotional batch, along with a naughty block-headed 28-year-old man: **sparklesgirl_1995**.

from all of the unfortunate events that i’ve been through, you think i would be out of Washiez entirely. however, i still choose to stick with Washiez since this community is for me. i’m wrapped around with individuals who i honor so greatly, whether they be inside or outside the Supervision+ Team, and i cannot wait for more memories to come. even if Washiez were to die out someday, there will always be a tight-knit group staying for each other. and that’s what i love to see in such a massive community like Washiez’s.

here, i stand as a strong community member of Washiez and a thankful founder of the **unofficial Washiez Promotion Logs Trello Board**. thank you, my editors, for always being so willing to provide for this Trello. and thank you to **hrtsforhope** and **coolspyel** for being there from the very start of its journey. :heart:
